name: Overfold
_about: AN OVERFOLD: the Doric peplos's apoptygma -- the top of the cloth folded down over the body from the shoulders' line (not the armpits: the bodice above it was a bare shelf) to the waist or below, hanging free in a front panel and a back one (the sides open, where the arms come out). A hem band may border it. Its folds fine and many (24 round: its front panel a third of that) -- ten round, the panel fell in three broad ones, a board.
